messages:
maria: quick follow-up from the postmortem — ETL lag on 2026-03-12 caused delayed spans and incorrect aggregations. we need owners, short ETAs, and verification steps to prevent recurrence.

ajay: I can own detection + dashboards. will add a rolling ETL latency panel and a missing-span counter; also add unique_service_span_ratio to canary. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

dave: I'll own the pipeline fix. root cause looks like a windowing regression after the reorder PR. plan: revert change in staging, add integration test for ordering edge-cases, and run a targeted backfill for 03/12-03/14. ETA: Wed COB.

sasha: I'll own alerts and CI gating. adding Prom alert: median_etl_processing_ms > 120s for 5m and a synthetic postdeploy span-count check. will gate the ordering integration test in CI. ETA: Tue AM.

observability-bot: Incident summary posted: https://redwood.internal/pms/ETL-2026-03-12  span-drop-rate spike x3, 3 alerts fired.

maria: please add PR links and a short runbook entry for oncall triage. note potential recurring pattern: similar spikes ~6-8 weeks after ordering-affecting deploys.

ajay: Dashboard PR: https://git.redwood/infr/mon/pulls/418. quick query to surface suspect batches:
```sql
SELECT batch_id, avg(processing_ms) as avg_ms, sum(missing_spans) as missing
FROM etl_metrics
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY batch_id
HAVING avg(processing_ms) > 120000 OR sum(missing_spans) > 0
ORDER BY avg_ms DESC
```

dave: Backfill PR: https://git.redwood/etl/pulls/396. staging revert commit: fe12a. flagged reorder change that opened a window gap. backfill job id: bf-20260315-7.

sasha: CI gating PR: https://git.redwood/ci/pulls/83  adds synthetic run + postdeploy validation. runbook snippet added: "If span-drop spike -> pause deploys, trigger backfill job id, notify #incidents and oncall, attach telemetry links."

maria: Ownership recap: Ajay (detection/dashboard) EOD tomorrow; Dave (pipeline fix + backfill) Wed COB; Sasha (alerts + CI gating) Tue AM. Ops: add runbook + link to postmortem doc.

ajay: will also prototype a low-noise anomaly detector to reduce false positives and add the metric to canary panels.

dave: added followup checklist to PM doc: https://redwood.docs/pm/etl-2026-03-12/followups with owners and due dates.

maria: scheduling 15m sync tomorrow 10:30 to confirm progress. if blocked ping me and tag @sasha or @ajay.

sasha: ack. I'll run a weekly regression query for 8 weeks; if we see 2 recurrences we escalate to a rollout freeze policy.

maria: thanks team. we'll close when dashboards merged, backfill completes, CI gating live, and runbook in place. I'll post final signoff here. :white_check_mark:
